sentences.text: It is submitted that defendant nos. 1 to 4, on 14th February, 2026, have published false and incorrect statements in the Delhi edition of the newspaper being Sakshi Newspaper, and on the news channel being Sakshi TV, against the plaintiffs.

The details of the defamatory statements published by defendant nos. 1 to 4, as given in the plaint, are as under:
"xxx xxx xxx 31.

On 14 February 2026, Defendant No. 1 in the Delhi Edition of the Newspaper published a self-authored article which contains incorrect, unfounded and defamatory statements against the Plaintiff (the "Impugned Article").
The Impugned Article was published on the front page of the Delhi Edition of the Newspaper with a logo of the Plaintiff No. 1 Company.
The Impugned Article was published on the website of Defendant No. 1 as well as physical news paper.
32. The Impugned Article alleges that Plaintiff No. 1 Company has ties with Bhole Baba Oroganic Dairy Milk Private Limited ("Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk").

33.

"Heritage Connection with "Bhole" too"
"TTD Ghee contracts to Bole Baba only during Chandrababus Government Tenure"
"The real conspiracy behind Chief Minister Chandrababus alleged smear campaign regarding the Tirumala Laddu Prasadam is gradually coming to light.

"Heritage Foods - Bhole Baba Connection: The business relationship between N.
Chandrababu Naidus family and Bhole Baba Dairy, which is at the center of the controversy regarding ghee supplies for the Tirumala Laddu Prasadam, has come to light.
It has recently been revealed that Heritage Foods, owned by Chandrababus family, maintains business ties with Bhole Baba Dairy.
Notably, Bhole Baba Dairy has explicitly mentioned on its official website that they have a business association with Heritage Foods.
The website clearly states, "We are associated with Heritage Foods."

This indicates that a long-standing business relationship has been ongoing between the two dairies."

26. Attention of this Court has also been drawn to the newspaper report dated 11th November, 2025,
published in the Economic Times, wherein, Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk has been imputed for setting up fake Ghee manufacturing unit, used to prepare Tirupati Laddus.
However, it is submitted that the plaintiffs have no connection with the aforesaid Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk.

It is submitted that the plaintiff has business dealings with another entity, namely Bhole Baba Milk Food Industries (Dholpur) Private Limited ("Bhole Baba Milk Food"), and that the same is an entirely different entity from Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk, which is the accused in the TTD scam.

Thus, learned Senior Counsel appearing for the plaintiffs submits that Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk and Bhole Baba Milk Food are distinct entities, and plaintiff no. 1-company has business ties with Bhole Baba Milk Food, and not Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk.
In fact, plaintiff no. 1-company has never entered into any business dealings with Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk.
29. Learned Senior Counsel appearing for the plaintiffs submits that the TTD scam is being investigated by the Central Bureau of Investigation ("CBI"), led by a Special Investigation Team ("SIT").
The SIT had registered a First Information Report ("FIR") against Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk and other accused persons, and two chargesheets have already been filed.
Notably, neither the plaintiff no. 1-company, nor Bhole Baba Milk Food has been named in the FIR, or the chargesheets filed with regard to the TTD scam.

30. Thus, it is submitted that defendant nos. 1 to 4 have maliciously published the impugned article,
making false and incorrect statements linking plaintiff no. 1 company with Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk, which is an accused in the TTD scam.

These imputations have been made with a deliberate attempt to tarnish the reputation of plaintiff no. 1-company.
31.

the defendant no. 4 has also maliciously published the false narrative on the platform of defendant no. 8, i.e., YouTube, which has 2.5 billion monthly users.
